title: The full suite runs 20.2-21.1 s at 100 ids on darwin, over its 20 s ceiling at any load, so the SP-m3azo2y7 review cannot finish
goal: The SP-m3azo2y7 review story's done ran tests.py 31 times on 2026-10-10: every run passed all 100 tests in 20.18-21.08 s and exited 1 on the darwin 20 s ceiling (D-776rvpx2), 21 of them at load averages 1.47-1.76, so waiting for a quiet host no longer helps (BG-ucwq6kga notes runs at 19.9-20.6 s before this sprint). The darwin max_seconds in _tools/tests_ceiling.json follows the operator's recorded answer to this item's gate, with that decision's id in the file, and a full tests.py run on this host exits 0.
repro_reason: a full suite run is the behaviour, but the review story's done already runs it; the repro pins the number the gate decides

gates.question: The suite passes all 100 tests in 20.2-21.1 s on darwin, over the 20 s ceiling: raise the darwin seconds, or cut the suite's time first?
options: keep darwin at 20 and cut the suite's time (a test-speed story) before the review can finish
